verses.text: And it came to pass, after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, and they were hearing him, and asking him questions.

title: JST, Luke 2:46. Compare Luke 2:46 The doctors in the temple listen to Jesus and ask Him questions.
